subject: Initial: LumenPay DPA request + SCCs / SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@lumenpay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@lumenpay.com>, LumenPay Legal <legal@lumenpay.com>
Date: 2023-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA + SCCs/SOC2 evidence request for onboarding

Hi Irene,

We're getting close to finalizing procurement for LumenPay. Our legal team has a couple of asks before we can sign:

- Can you provide a customer DPA (we've attached our standard template for reference)?
- We need confirmation on SCCs applicability and a signed DPA with the EU data residency language retained (they're asking for Europe-only processing).
- Please include SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter of attestation) and a CAIQ/consensys-like summary for security controls.
- Also confirm data retention and deletion timeline for end-customer PII and whether subprocessor list is available.

Timeline: legal needs this by EOD Monday (2023-09-11) to hit our internal go-live. Let us know if that timeline works and who at Redwood will own redlines.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel | Head of Procurement, LumenPay
[Attachment: LumenPay_DPA_Template.docx (docx)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2023-09-04T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA + SCCs/SOC2 evidence request for onboarding

Team — forwarding LumenPay's request. Key asks: EU-only residency language, SOC 2/CAIQ evidence, retention windows, subprocessor list.

Can LegalOps and Sales Ops align on an owner for redlines and confirm whether we can accept the EU-only residency carve? If not, we should plan for an exec escalation + an explicit fallback (e.g., limited subprocessor commitments + contractual safeguards).

Preferred next steps:
- Legal: quick pass on their template and mark non-starters
- Security: produce SOC2 attestation link / CAIQ extract
- Sales: confirm timeline and whether a finance/contracting exception is acceptable to the customer

I can own the coordination with the customer and send a short note asking for flexibility on the residency ask while we triage.

Irene
Irene Choi | Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2023-09-04T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA + SCCs/SOC2 evidence request for onboarding

Thanks — I'll coordinate the signature path and timing. Proposed plan:

1) LegalOps (Neha) to produce a redline against the customer's template by EOD today and flag any absolute no-go terms (e.g., broad EU-only processing with no carve for infra routing).
2) Security to provide SOC 2 Type II letter & CAIQ extract (Irene, can you ping security for a CAIQ export?).
3) If the customer insists on EU-only residency, we'll escalate to VP BizDev for a limited carveout decision (we need to know if Dedicated/Private deployment is required).

I'll prepare a signer matrix and estimate a DocuSign envelope ready for review. Attaching a short note for redline best practices.

-Karthik
[Attachment: redline_instructions.md (txt)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2023-09-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA + SCCs/SOC2 evidence request for onboarding

Folks — redline pass attached. Summary of material changes we recommend and open questions:

- Retain SCCs as standard but do NOT accept a strict EU-only processing obligation in the DPA; propose language that requires us to use appropriate safeguards and to notify customers of data transfers with location commitments where feasible.
- Add 90-day deletion timeline for end-customer PII after contract termination (we can negotiate retention categories separately).
- Provide subprocessor list with a 30-day notice for new subprocessors; carve private deployment exceptions for regulated customers.
- SOC 2: security will provide the Type II report link; redaction may be needed for vendor names.

If the customer pushes EU-only, we should route to VP Sales for an exception and consider Dedicated capacity as an option (commercial uplift). I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope once exec approval lane is confirmed.

Attached: LumenPay_DPA_v0.1_redlined.pdf

-Neha
Neha Kapoor | Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: LumenPay_DPA_v0.1_redlined.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@lumenpay.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2023-09-04T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs/SOC2 evidence request for onboarding

Hi Sam / Amanda — thanks for the clear asks and the template. We're attached a redline and proposed language for retention and subprocessors. Quick notes:

- SOC 2 Type II attestation and a CAIQ extract are in flight; security will share a download link by tomorrow morning.
- We cannot accept an EU-only obligation as written; we proposed alternative language that preserves guarantees while allowing for necessary routing and subprocessors. If EU-only is a hard requirement, please flag and we'll escalate to our sales leadership and ops for a potential Dedicated deployment discussion.
- We're aiming to have an executed DPA by 2023-09-05 if we can align on residence language — DocuSign envelope will be sent to the signers you confirm.

Next steps for LumenPay: please confirm the preferred signer (legal sig or executive) and whether the EU-only residency is mandatory. If you can confirm by EOD 2023-09-04, we'll proceed with the fastest path.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
[DocuSign preflight: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-LP ]
